background: SHA256(domain || semantic_candidate_sha256_bytes || counter_le_u64), mapped bytewise to 0x20..=0x7e, then deterministically repaired until the literal has zero overlapping occurrences
repair: replace the final byte of the leftmost occurrence with the smallest printable ASCII byte absent from the literal, then resume at max(0, start-width+1)
sole_match_guard: replace up to width-1 adjacent bytes on each side with the absent sentinel before inserting the literal; require exactly one overlapping occurrence
dense: repeat the exact literal from offset zero while reserving a nonempty absent-sentinel suffix
endpoint_misses: repeat a width-byte block differing from the literal only at the named endpoint, using the absent sentinel; width-one endpoint scenarios are intentionally byte-identical but remain distinct scenario rows
mutation_scenarios: for every literal offset, repeat a width-byte block differing only at that offset, guard the final width-1 prefix bytes, and insert the sole exact literal at fixture_bytes-literal_bytes
oracle: scalar overlapping leftmost span plus scalar nonoverlapping count over every complete fixture
